protocol.scope: Exploratory clip-grouped development cross-validation at four previously examined sites. Observable events in the next 30 frames (3 s), derived from historical and future ground tracks. Five one-vs-rest supervised probes per representation. No existing model weights are read or changed.
protocol.folds: Five fixed folds. Process sites in ascending name order. Within each site sort whole clips by descending window count then ascending name. Place each clip in the fold with fewest windows from that site, then fewest windows overall, then fewest clips from that site, then lowest fold ID. No event labels, scores, threshold optimization or class balancing in the split.
protocol.features: All models use the same 5 historical ground points: per-frame relative xy, vx, vy, speed, the event rule's mean pre-event speed and its start/stop eligibility flags. Last pose adds 17 relative joint xy and valid flags at t0. Ordered changes add four successive 17-joint signed xy differences and pair-validity flags. A pair needs a valid joint with the same root convention at both endpoints. Invalid differences are zero. Pose coordinates are normalized by the respective box heights. The pose increments include availability information and detector noise.
protocol.fit: Same folds, unweighted samples, independent binary logistic models. Per-column mean and population SD estimated only on training windows; divisor 1 for zero SD. Fixed C=0.1, summed log loss plus ||w||²/(2C), unpenalized intercept. SciPy L-BFGS-B, maxiter=2000, ftol=1e-12, gtol=1e-8. A single-class training event predicts its training frequency (0 or 1). No fit selects hyperparameters.
protocol.metrics: Each row receives one out-of-fold probability per event and representation. Window-pooled AP uses one threshold per unique score (ties grouped); F1 uses fixed >=0.5. Zero-positive evaluation events have null AP/F1, retain confusion counts and are excluded from that group's class macro. Fold and site metrics are descriptive. Each fold contains clips from every site.
protocol.history_eligible: Within each event's eligible windows, score the same trained models and a constant baseline estimated only from eligible training rows in the respective fold. If none are eligible in training, use its overall training event frequency. Eligibility uses only the last three causal smoothed speeds: mean <=0.20 m/s for start, >=0.60 m/s for stop.

independent_oof_check.method: Computed AP as average precision at the inclusive score threshold of each true positive, accounting for ties with exact fractions. Rebuilt threshold-0.5 confusion counts, AP and F1 within each fold, each site, pooled and the two eligible subsets. Rebuilt eligible prevalence from training folds only. The extracted JSON matches the ZIP member byte for byte.
